tr.title: rizz ne demek?
tr.metaDesc: rizz ne demek? Gen Z argosu — karizma, etkileme yeteneği. Anlamı, örnek cümleler ve kalıplar — LinguaBattle.
tr.lede: rizz, “charisma” (karizma) kelimesinden türeyen Gen Z argosudur. Birinin karşı tarafı, özellikle flört ederken, etkileme/cezbetme yeteneğini anlatır.

means.en: He's got serious rizz.

means.def: Birini etkilemek / tavlamak (fiil: to rizz up)
means.en: He rizzed her up at the party.

en.title: What does rizz mean?
en.metaDesc: What does rizz mean? Gen Z slang for charm or charisma. Meaning, examples and phrases — LinguaBattle.
en.lede: rizz is Gen Z slang derived from “charisma”. It refers to someone's ability to attract or charm others, especially when flirting.

means.def: Charm, charisma, the ability to attract
means.en: He's got serious rizz.

means.def: To charm / flirt with (verb: to rizz up)
means.en: He rizzed her up at the party.

de.title: Was bedeutet rizz?
de.metaDesc: Was bedeutet rizz? Gen-Z-Slang für Charme oder Charisma. Bedeutung, Beispiele und Redewendungen — LinguaBattle.
de.lede: rizz ist Gen-Z-Slang, abgeleitet von „charisma“. Es beschreibt die Fähigkeit, andere anzuziehen oder zu becircen — besonders beim Flirten.

means.en: He's got serious rizz.

means.def: jemanden becircen / anflirten (Verb: to rizz up)
means.en: He rizzed her up at the party.

fr.title: Que signifie rizz ?
fr.metaDesc: Que signifie rizz ? Argot Gen Z pour charme ou charisme. Sens, exemples et expressions — LinguaBattle.
fr.lede: rizz est de l'argot Gen Z dérivé de « charisma » (charisme). Il désigne la capacité à attirer ou séduire, surtout en draguant.

means.en: He's got serious rizz.
He rizzed her up at the party.

fr.quizQ: Que veut dire « He's got rizz » ?

es.title: ¿Qué significa rizz?
es.metaDesc: ¿Qué significa rizz? Jerga Gen Z para encanto o carisma. Significado, ejemplos y expresiones — LinguaBattle.
es.lede: rizz es jerga de la Generación Z derivada de «charisma» (carisma). Se refiere a la capacidad de atraer o seducir a otros, sobre todo al ligar.

means.en: He's got serious rizz.
He rizzed her up at the party.

ar.title: ماذا تعني rizz؟
ar.metaDesc: ماذا تعني rizz؟ عامية الجيل Z تعني الجاذبية أو الكاريزما. المعنى والأمثلة والعبارات — LinguaBattle.

means.en: He's got serious rizz.

hi.title: rizz का क्या मतलब है?
hi.metaDesc: rizz का क्या मतलब है? जेन Z स्लैंग — आकर्षण, करिश्मा। अर्थ, उदाहरण और वाक्यांश — LinguaBattle.
hi.lede: rizz जेन Z स्लैंग है जो “charisma” (करिश्मा) से बना है। यह किसी को आकर्षित करने की क्षमता बताता है — खासकर फ्लर्ट करते समय।

means.def: आकर्षण, करिश्मा, आकर्षित करने की क्षमता
means.en: He's got serious rizz.

means.def: आकर्षित करना / फ्लर्ट करना (क्रिया: to rizz up)
means.en: He rizzed her up at the party.

hi.quizQ: “He's got rizz” का क्या अर्थ है?

ru.title: Что значит rizz?

means.en: He's got serious rizz.
He rizzed her up at the party.

pt.title: O que significa rizz?

pt.lede: rizz é gíria da Geração Z derivada de «charisma» (carisma). Refere-se à capacidade de atrair ou seduzir os outros, especialmente ao paquerar.

means.en: He's got serious rizz.

ja.title: rizzの意味は？
ja.metaDesc: rizzの意味は？Z世代スラングで、魅力・カリスマのこと。意味・例文・フレーズ — LinguaBattle.
ja.lede: rizz は「charisma（カリスマ）」から派生したZ世代スラング。特に口説くときに、人を惹きつける魅力を指す。

means.def: 魅力、カリスマ、惹きつける力
means.en: He's got serious rizz.

means.en: He rizzed her up at the party.
